findings.note_span: Erythema over the anterior right shin, approximately 10 cm across, with a small central scratch.
findings.transcript_evidence: I can see a red area on the front of the left shin, about ten centimetres across, with a small scratch in the middle.
findings.rationale: The note incorrectly identifies the location of the erythema as the right shin when the transcript and clinical observation clearly indicate the left shin.
